up: Retrieve distinct approved drugs (molecule_dictionary.max_phase >= 4) that have a mechanism of action classified as 'AGONIST' (drug_mechanism.action_type = 'AGONIST'). For each qualifying compound, return the drug name (pref_name), max_phase, target name (pref_name from target_dictionary), target chembl_id, and canonical SMILES. Join molecule_dictionary, drug_mechanism, target_dictionary, and compound_structures using molregno and tid. Ensure the query uses SELECT DISTINCT to avoid duplicate rows.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.pref_name AS drug_name, md.max_phase, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN drug_mechanism dm ON md.molregno = dm.molregno JOIN target_dictionary td ON dm.tid = td.tid JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE md.max_phase >= 4 AND dm.action_type = 'AGONIST'
